subject.title: Telegram voice message delayed ~15 minutes before agent dispatch, then run aborts

question: Should Telegram add source message.date-to-dispatch latency detection and what visible fallback should direct aborted/no-final voice turns send?
rationale: Those choices affect restart thresholds, retry behavior, and user-visible error text in a live channel, and the current issue already carries maintainer-review/product/live-repro signals.

options.title: Define the narrow policy first
options.body: Choose a latency threshold, restart/alert behavior, and direct-message fallback text before any fix PR is queued.

options.title: Split the remaining work
options.body: Keep this issue as the latency/dispatch item and track the no-final voice fallback under the adjacent voice recovery report.

options.title: Wait for live repro only
options.body: Defer code changes until a maintainer or reporter captures a current-main Telegram voice-note replay with redacted logs.

recommendation.title: Define the narrow policy first
recommendation.body: Choose a latency threshold, restart/alert behavior, and direct-message fallback text before any fix PR is queued.

likelyOwner.reason: Josh has recent merged history in the polling, spooled replay, and claim-refresh paths most likely to own the ingress/retry boundary decision.
